page.overview:
Who is Egwene al'Vere?

Egwene is described as beautiful, with large brown eyes and long dark hair. She was 5'3" (or 160 cm) in height. She briefly wore her hair in a braid, the Two Rivers symbol that a woman has come of age. But after she began taking lessons from Moiraine shortly after departing the Two Rivers she began wearing her hair down because "Aes Sedai don't braid their hair. At least, not unless they want to."

Egwene is described as wanting to learn everything, as fast as possible; she chafes against the restrictions her teachers put on her, even those set for her own safety. Moiraine Damodred made note of Egwene's social intuition; even when she may not have understand the private or secret machinations going on around her, she was often (at least) aware that they were happening.

She had a fairly unique perspective of the role of Aes Sedai in society, having spent only a short time as a novice in the White Tower before being taken by the Seanchan and a similarly short time in the Tower as an Accepted before eventually training with the Wise Ones. Her opinion of the Tower as an organization, however, remained very high, and she subscribed to the school of Aes Sedai thought that the White Tower should "guide" Rand al'Thor to achieve the best outcome for the world.

After being installed as a puppet Amyrlin, she began to gain skills in the manipulation of others.

Also known as: Egwene, Amyrlin.
